about: Which user-role records are not the person speaking. A record is not the person's words when, after every block below is removed (outer tag with everything inside it), nothing is left; or when it starts with one of the prefixes. If any text is left, it is the person's words and is kept verbatim. The writing loop reads this same file, so the two cannot drift apart. "inbox": 1 says this plugin also speaks for other sources: a source writes what it would say into <state dir>/inbox/<source>.<...>.json and the plugin says it, once, under one rule for which turns get what; without this key the writing loop speaks for itself. A note may also carry "verdict": {"ready": true or false, "text": "<one line>"}, the source's verdict on the work it tracks, one per note. The plugin does not relay it; when a reply ends by saying the work is done or ready to submit while a note of that conversation says "ready": false, the next turn says so once. Any other shape, null included, is reported as unreadable; with no verdict, leave the key out.
prefixes: The app was quit while you were working.
